home: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop 1440x1000 screenshot of a usable Chinese resume creation web application "简历工坊", a distinct original design with calm indigo-blue #465fe9 accents, very pale cool-gray canvas #f6f7fb, white surfaces, dark navy typography, generous space and refined PingFang sans Chinese text. Entire primary home workspace screen, not a marketing hero. No stock images or raster decorations, only code-native UI, Lucide outlined icons, and actual typeset resume document previews. All elements practical HTML/CSS, consistent 10px radii and 1px light borders. Top horizontal 76px white navigation: typographic name 简历工坊 with small document icon, nav 简历模板 我的简历 使用指南, right 导入简历 outlined button and blue 新建简历 button. Main 1180px centered area starting at y125. Large headline "让你的经历，值得被看见。" at 38px, one subtitle "从一份好模板开始，写下你的下一程。" at 15px muted. Right of heading unobtrusive "本地保存 · 无需登录" with small shield outline. Following at y245 a pale blue horizontal slim 100px continue-draft region: left document outline and "产品经理 · 求职简历" with "示例简历，点击开始编辑", right "继续编辑" button. Section at y395 "挑选适合你的简历模板", right small "3 款精选模板". At y445 filter tabs 全部模板, 简约专业, 校园求职, 设计创意 and right search input "搜索模板". Three equal columns of actual A4 resume preview papers on cool light gray frames at y500-865, with names below and arrow actions. First template "经典简约", subtitle "清晰的层次，让经历一目了然", navy simple single column typeset Chinese resume 林知夏, 产品经理. Second "左右分栏", subtitle "信息分区，突出你的专业优势", muted navy left column and white right. Third "现代线条", subtitle "利落线条，呈现独特的个人风格", blue thin rules. Each preview uses legible proper resume content not skeleton placeholder lines. Footer small local privacy note "简历仅保存在当前浏览器，你可以随时导出备份。". Make full screen composed beautifully with all template labels visible. No fake testimonials, no fake metrics, no badge above heading, no unrelated AI features.
editor: Use case: ui-mockup. Design the complete resume editor state for the Chinese app 简历工坊. High fidelity desktop browser app screenshot 1440x1000, generous clean modern production UI. White app chrome, pale cool-gray #f6f7fb preview background, accent indigo-blue #465fe9, navy text, outlined Lucide style icons, PingFang Chinese sans. All UI and resume text will be real HTML CSS not images. Top 72px white bar: left back arrow and 简历工坊 wordmark, vertical divider, editable title "产品经理 · 求职简历"; right muted check "已保存到本地", outlined "备份", primary blue "导出 PDF" button. Below white top-tab/control bar height64: left 内容编辑 selected and 外观设置; right preview controls 实时预览 and 75%. Main left white edit pane width450 with 32px padding, right large gray canvas with center A4 white resume paper width590 height835 and subtle shadow. Left pane accordion sections: expanded 基本信息 with two-column form pairs 姓名 林知夏, 求职意向 产品经理, 电话 138 0000 0000, 邮箱 lin.zhixia@example.com, 所在城市 上海, 个人网站 空; multiline field 个人简介 with 3 lines. Below collapsed sections 工作经历 "2 段经历", 教育经历 "1 段经历", 项目经历 "1 个项目", 专业技能. Visible right paper has margins46, big 林知夏 title, small 产品经理, compact phone email city on one row then thin navy rule, personal summary, 工作经历 with two jobs "轻舟科技" and "向新数字", date ranges right, real Chinese descriptions with bullets, 教育经历 "华东理工大学" and degree/date, 项目经历 with actionable descriptions, 专业技能. Paper typography fine 11px at preview scale, headings14px navy. Bottom left subtle information 本地自动保存. Clearly readable, spacious left controls, calm professional whitespace, no decorative logos, fake AI features or ornamental labels. Preserve clear separation of form and preview.
